scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, largely correct investigation with an excellent independent verification step (downloading and parsing the NuGet assemblies). It self-corrected a TFM misattribution and gave a concrete, well-reasoned fix. Shortfalls: it never actually read the App.config XML content (explicitly requested), instead inferring it — though it was transparent about this — and it did not explicitly flag the misleading MSB3277 message. Some wasted steps chasing missing temp files early on.
scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
